raw_response:
*Old farmer, 69, thinking out loud over tea*

Ai, 2 mu of land, wheat and maize, same as I've always done. My wife and I, we're not young anymore — our son works in town at the factory so it's just the two of us out there most days. 50 years on this same piece of ground. I know every corner of it.

The wheat is already in — I put it down back in October like always, around the time the weather turns cold. It's coming up green now, not bad. I walked the field yesterday. Soon I need to think about the spring topdress and watering.

**For the wheat this spring:** I always put down one bag of compound fertilizer before planting in the fall — that was done already, cost me about 150 yuan for one 50-kg bag, enough for my 2 mu. Now at jointing, when the wheat stands up tall, I'll topdress with urea. One bag of urea is 50 kg, I'll use maybe half a bag on the 2 mu — that's about 12-13 kg per mu of urea, which my neighbor Old Wang says is enough, he does about the same. That works out to around 16 kg N per mu for the whole wheat season. Any more and it's just wasting money, fertilizer price keeps going up.

**Watering the wheat:** The well still works, but pumping costs money. I'll water at jointing — that's the important one, my father always said so — and again at grain-filling if it doesn't rain. Maybe one more before winter if it was dry (I already did that one in December). So three waterings total. Two mu doesn't take long but the electricity bill adds up.

**Spraying:** A bit of herbicide in spring when the weeds come up, I buy a small bottle at the agro shop in town, maybe 20 yuan covers my 2 mu. If aphids get bad at heading I'll spray once, but usually it's fine.

**Harvesting wheat:** Early June. I pay the combine operator who comes through the village — he charges by the mu. Then I need to turn around fast and get maize in. That week is always tiring.

**For the maize:** Right after wheat, mid-June, no time to waste. I buy hybrid seed at the shop — the "Zhengdan" or whatever variety Old Wang bought last year, he got good maize. About 30 yuan per mu for seed. No tillage, just direct seed — my nephew has a little seeder he brings over, I give him some maize at harvest. 

For maize fertilizer I do about the same as wheat — one bag of compound at planting spread across the 2 mu, and topdress half a bag of urea when the maize is knee-high. That's about 14 kg N per mu total. My plants are usually good and green.

**Watering maize:** Maize is hungrier for water but summer rain usually helps. I'll water once for sure at tasseling if the sky is dry. Maybe twice if it's a dry summer. The well water costs about 50 yuan each time for 2 mu.

**Labor:** Just me and the wife. She helps at harvest and planting. My son comes back for the busy week in June sometimes. We don't hire anybody — 2 mu is small, no point paying outside people. Maybe 25-30 days of work across the whole year between the two of us.

**Yield:** Last year I got about 420 kg of wheat per mu and almost 500 kg of maize per mu. Should be similar this year if the weather holds. That's enough flour for us and some to sell for cash. The maize mostly goes to sell, prices weren't great last year but what can you do.
